description.value: Empire Coffee is a specialty cafe in downtown Nelson, founded in 2015 and named after a vintage 1913 steam boiler from the adjacent Adventure Hotel — sections of which are displayed throughout the space. The cafe serves Stumptown direct-trade coffees, loose-leaf organic teas, and a deli menu of sandwiches, pastries, salads, and soups. The atrium hosts live music on Thursday evenings, making it a lively stop in Nelson's walkable core.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: bollard (2 spaces) at 62m; bollard (2 spaces) at 72m. Total: 4 spaces.
